name: srm-enterprises
description: SRM Enterprises — Separated Frontend (Next.js) & Backend (Express API).

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace srm-frontend" "npm run dev --workspace srm-backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace srm-backend && npm run build --workspace srm-frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace srm-backend && npm run lint --workspace srm-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace srm-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace srm-frontend
